request.initial_prompt: The elder Cato, returning consul from Spain, sold his warhorse to save the money it would have cost in bringing it back by sea into Italy; and being Governor of Sardinia, he made all his visits on foot, without other train than one officer of the Republic who carried his robe and a censer for sacrifices, and for the most part carried his trunk himself. raw_segments.text: The elder Cato, returning consul from Spain, sold his warhorse to save the money it would have cost in bringing it back by sea into Italy,
and being Governor of Sardinia, he made all his visits on foot, without other train than one officer of the Republic
who carried his robe and a censer for sacrifices, and for the most part carried his trunk himself.

He bragged that he had never worn a gown that cost above ten crowns, nor had ever sent above tenpence to the market for one day's provision, and that as to his country houses, he had not one that was rough-cast on the outside.
